explain.en: Models and datasets downloaded from ModelScope. They are downloaded again when a program needs them. Your ModelScope login is kept elsewhere and is not affected.
explain.zh: 从魔搭 ModelScope 下载的模型和数据集。程序需要时会重新下载。魔搭的登录信息存在别处，不受影响。

notes: The whole ~/.cache/modelscope is the cache root: older SDKs write hub/, newer ones (modelscope-hub 0.4.6) models/ and datasets/. Credentials are in ~/.modelscope/credentials and downloaded skills in ~/.agents/skills (modelscope_hub/constants.py), both outside this rule. Not present on the maintainer's Mac.
